notes: This ledger is deliberately conservative until every P0/P1 requirement and named test case is mapped to current automated or captured local evidence.
The two P2 FRs are inventoried but do not block the first formal release.
G7-G10 evidence is necessary but cannot by itself set this ledger to PASS.
FR-AUT-002 has implementation-level loopback client/webhook evidence, but remains PARTIAL until formal three-viewport production UAT and release evidence are captured.

FR-AUD-001 is promoted to PASS only because the mapped Windows SAPI runtime and three-viewport governance evidence are both explicit PASS records, and the API/UI tests cover immutable text revision, voice/profile provenance, audition candidate, selection, idempotency and finalize replay.

NFR-REL-003 remains PARTIAL: the explicit PASS upgrade/restore rehearsal and clean-root online-backup restore UAT prove backup integrity, restore, API/read/review and 100 media hashes, but the evidence does not yet record an explicit restored-index rebuild/query-plan check.

FR-AUT-001, FR-CTL-002, FR-REV-001, FR-IMG-001..006, FR-AST-001, FR-GEN-001..010, FR-JOB-001..005 and FR-OPS/PRV-001..003 now have implementation-level API/UI evidence and remain PARTIAL until formal three-viewport production UAT is captured.
